SELECT distinct ac.config_id, ac.pos_type, ac.preset_id, COALESCE (vp.preset_name,ac.preset_name) as presetName, ac.device_code,ac.channel_code
FROM vm_algorithm_config ac LEFT JOIN vm_video_preset vp on vp.preset_id = ac.preset_id WHERE ac.delete_flag = '0' and ac.industry_code = #{industryCode} and ac.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (ac.device_code, ac.channel_code) in
(#{item.deviceCode}, #{item.channelCode})
SELECT device_code from vm_channel_info_t where channel_code = #{channelCode} and delete_flag = '0'
select algorithm_status from vm_algorithm_config where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: update vm_algorithm_config set algorithm_status = #{pushStatus} where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: select a.tenant_name from sys_tenant_info a where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.del_flag = 0

SELECT t2.model_code modelCode, t2.device_model_code deviceModelCode, t3.pic_sensor_length picSensorLength, t3.pic_sensor_width picSensorWidth, t3.min_focus minFocus FROM vm_device_info_t t2 LEFT JOIN vm_device_model_t t3 ON t2.model_code = t3.mfgr_code AND t2.device_model_code = t3.device_model_code WHERE t2.delete_flag = '0' AND t2.device_code = #{deviceCode}

#{labelIdItem}
